sans-serif;font-size:11.0px;font-weight:700;">Stimulus (input into the system)</text><text x="105.0" y="86" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">RECEPTOR</text><text x="105.0" y="100" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;">(e.g. free nerve</text><text x="105.0" y="114" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;">ending in the skin)</text><text x="265.0" y="86" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">INTEGRATOR</text><text x="265.0" y="100" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;">(such as the brain)</text><text x="420.0" y="86" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">EFFECTORS</text><text x="420.0" y="100" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;">(a muscle or</text><text x="420.0" y="114" text-anchor="middle" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;">a gland)</text><text x="500" y="60" text-anchor="start" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">RESPONSE</text><text x="486" y="74" text-anchor="start" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">(system's output)</text><text x="150" y="152" text-anchor="start" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">The response to the stimulus leads to change.</text><text x="150" y="167" text-anchor="start" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">The change is fed back to the receptor.</text><text x="150" y="182" text-anchor="start" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">In negative feedback, the response of the system</text><text x="150" y="197" text-anchor="start" fill="#111827" style="font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:10.0px;font-weight:700;">cancels or counteracts the effect of the original stimulus.</text></svg>
